answer.answer: What changed: Atlas Runner 1.1 raised the supported concurrency limit from 8 to 16 concurrent jobs [atlas-release-2]. What is current: Per the latest supplied release notes, Atlas Runner 1.1 supports up to 16 concurrent jobs [atlas-release-2]. What remains historically valid: Atlas Runner 1.0 supported up to 8 concurrent jobs, as documented in its release notes [atlas-release-1]; this remains true as a statement about version 1.0 even though it is superseded by 1.1's higher limit. Unresolved: No supplied snapshot covers versions after 1.1, so later changes to the limit cannot be confirmed or denied; the sources also do not clarify whether these figures are hard caps or configurable values, nor do they address other editions or deployment modes.
